name: vizora-tv
description: Vizora Digital Signage Display Client for Android TV
author: Vizora <support@vizora.io>

scripts.android:dev: npm run build && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.android:build: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run build && cap sync android && cap run android
scripts.android:run:device: npm run build && cap sync android && cap run android --target
scripts.tizen:build: npm run build:tv && node scripts/package-tv.mjs tizen
scripts.webos:build: npm run build:tv && node scripts/package-tv.mjs webos
scripts.tv:build: npm run build:tv && node scripts/package-tv.mjs all
scripts.postinstall: echo Run: npm run cap:init then npm run cap:add:android
